command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
printf '%s  run.sh\n%s  subject.sh\n' ead60f7aab68bf2c4da6e5061bb4a5d664e7654c635b41751f563f92030189b4 f0a9b2db05a70794d10c1711066ab757d560d56ba4e175b6225abbb56002d2ae | sha256sum -c --quiet || { echo "FAIL: a script does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
bash /tmp/run.sh 16 0
RC=$?
{ echo "uname_m $(uname -m)"; grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo; grep -m1 'CPU part' /proc/cpuinfo; echo "cpus_online $(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null)"; echo "thread_siblings_cpu0 $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/topology/thread_siblings_list 2>/dev/null)"; awk -F: '/^siblings/{s=$2} /^cpu cores/{c=$2} END{if(c) print "threads_per_core", s/c}' /proc/cpuinfo; command -v lscpu >/dev/null 2>&1 && lscpu | grep -i -E 'thread|core|socket'; } >> /tmp/topology.txt 2>&1 || true
# ^ the chip legs' topology record: it describes the box and cannot fail the run.
/tmp/fsl/bin/python -I -c "import ctypes,glob; l=ctypes.CDLL(sorted(glob.glob('/tmp/fsl/lib/libopenblas*.so*'))[0]); l.openblas_get_corename.restype=ctypes.c_char_p; print('openblas_corename', l.openblas_get_corename().decode())" >> /tmp/topology.txt 2>&1 || true
exit $RC
